description: List FreeAgent contacts (clients and suppliers). Returns contact URL, name, email, status and outstanding account balance. Use the contact URL when raising an invoice or entering a supplier bill.

limit.description: Maximum contacts to fetch (default 100, max 1000). The server pages through as many requests as needed; `search` is applied to everything fetched.

search.description: Case-insensitive filter on name or email, applied to the results

name: freeagent_list_contacts
